blueprint.title: The Broke Neighbor and the Big Box
blueprint.setting: A residential apartment building hallway, on a rainy Saturday afternoon.
blueprint.problem: 小红 has moved a heavy box into the building elevator but runs out of money before the elevator arrives, leaving her stuck on the stairs with the box.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 小红 accidentally spills her bus fare tokens while struggling with the heavy box in the building lobby.

beats.where: The apartment building lobby and stairwell entrance
beats.what: 小红 is trying to push a large cardboard box into the building. She slips, and her coins fall into a drain or under a gap where she cannot reach them. She realizes she has no money to take the elevator to her 6th-floor apartment.
李明 comes home from work. He sees 小红 standing there looking worried. He recognizes her as the new neighbor he met briefly earlier that week.
beats.because: The noise of the dropping coins and 小红's distress attracts 李明's attention as he enters the building.

beats.what: 李明 asks what is wrong. 小红 explains that she is a woman who lives in the new apartment, but she lost the money for the elevator. She feels embarrassed.
beats.because: 李明 has observed her situation and initiated contact.

beats.what: 李明 explains that because they are neighbors, helping each other is important. He says that if someone is in trouble, they should ask for help.
beats.because: 小红 has explained her financial inability to take the elevator.

beats.what: 李明 tells 小红 that she needs to save her strength. He offers to carry the box for her. 小红 agrees.
beats.because: 李明 has established a supportive relationship and offered a solution to the physical burden.

beats.where: Outside 小红's apartment door on the 6th floor
beats.what: They arrive at the door. 小红 thanks 李明. She realizes that being helpful is necessary for a good neighborhood relationship.
beats.because: 李明 physically carried the box up the six flights of stairs as offered.

blueprint.resolution: 李明 helps 小红 carry the box to her floor, resolving the physical problem of moving the item and the social awkwardness of the lost money.

blueprint.title: The Key and the Neighbor
blueprint.setting: A Monday evening, 6:00 PM, in a residential apartment building.
blueprint.problem: 李明 cannot enter his apartment because he locked the door with the keys inside.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 李明 arrives home, realizes he has no keys, and sees 小红 leaving her apartment.

beats.where: Inside the elevator on the 1st floor
beats.what: 李明 gets into the elevator. He talks to himself about his day.

beats.where: In the hallway of the 6th floor
beats.what: The elevator doors open. 李明 walks out of the elevator and goes to his apartment door.
beats.because: 李明 needed to get from the 1st floor to the 6th floor to go home
beats.arrivedHow: 李明 walked out of the elevator and down the hallway

beats.what: 李明 tries to open the door, but it is locked. He looks in his pockets and finds no keys. 小红 opens her door next to his.
beats.because: 李明 needed to enter his apartment

beats.what: 李明 explains to 小红 that he is a 男人 (man) living here, but he has no keys. He says he 需要 (needs) help.
beats.because: 李明 found the door locked and 小红 was watching him

beats.what: 小红 asks if they are 关系 (good friends/close relationship) like neighbors who help each other. She says 如果 (if) he is really lost, she will call his 妈妈 (Mom).
beats.because: 小明 wanted to verify if 李明 was actually the resident before helping

beats.what: 李明's 妈妈 arrives. She helps 李明 open the door. 李明 thanks her for the 帮助 (help).
beats.because: 小红 called 妈妈 in the previous beat

blueprint.resolution: 李明's mother arrives and unlocks the door, resolving the lockout.
